answer: An author's identity survives only through a live voyage, not a stored credential. First, verifier broadcasts a fresh random seed; author must re-derive full reasoning chain within 90 seconds, spending roughly 12000 tokens. Correct output plus matching intermediate checkpoints emits a validity signal confirming genuine cognition. If the chain diverges or stalls, claim drops to zero and bonded deposit slashes. A copied fable of past answers cannot reproduce the new seed, so fake siblings pay real compute each round, making 10000 sybils cost near $40000 daily.
